entries.notes: Best current compilation donor. Small Node CLI, MIT-licensed, deterministic Pandoc/LaTeX seam, and directly relevant to EPUB/paperback/hardcover packaging.

entries.role: Supervised future KDP browser-submission adapter donor
entries.notes: Relevant only for a later supervised submission boundary. It automates the brittle KDP UI and must not become autonomous publish logic.
Useful orchestration, chapter-extension and compile-flow patterns, but heavy shell/runtime coupling and no clear license for code adoption.

entries.role: Structured planning/workspace pattern source for future book-production pilots
entries.notes: Strong plan/workspace models and KDP packaging scripts, but heavy provider/runtime stack and no clear license for code adoption.

entries.role: Minimal legacy reference for prompt-to-pdf KDP generation
entries.notes: Too thin and outdated to justify adoption. It does not provide the control, provenance or packaging boundaries ABVX needs.

entries.role: Reference catalog for future book-workflow donor discovery
entries.notes: Useful discovery list, not an implementation donor.

entries.role: Reference catalog for broad AI-writing landscape only
entries.notes: Broad category list; too generic for concrete Book Factory adoption decisions.

entries.role: Translation workflow donor with provider abstraction, formatting preservation, glossary and resume support
entries.notes: Strongest current translation workflow donor for future pilot. Real implementation with EPUB/DOCX/TXT support, checkpoints, glossary/state management and local/cloud provider flexibility.

entries.role: Offline-first long-book translation donor with terminology, cache and staged QA
entries.notes: Strong local/Ollama-first translation candidate with terminology manager, translation cache and staged review. More opinionated and heavier than hydropix, but strongest free/local pattern source.
Repository exists but offers weaker observable architecture and contract boundaries than the stronger translation candidates audited here.

entries.role: Skill-style translation workflow donor with provider abstraction and QA reports
entries.notes: Commercially restricted license and skill-oriented packaging make it unsuitable for direct adoption, but it is a useful pattern source for two-pass review, glossary/style guides and report generation.

entries.role: Character-consistency and img-memory pattern donor for manga/comic production
entries.notes: Strongest current character-consistency donor. Not a full comic factory, but an excellent reusable pattern for visual memory, variants/evolutions and fail-closed reference gating.
Strongest end-to-end comic architecture pattern. Valuable for future contracts around script, storyboard, lettering, QC and PDF/CBZ packaging.

entries.role: Comic generation app reference with panel/speech types and provider options
entries.notes: Interesting demo/app, but too dependent on external rendering stack and not strong enough as a recoverable production donor.
Useful as a simple demo of page chaining and optional character reference, but not a sufficient production donor for resumable or editable visual storytelling.
Observed repository is essentially API/marketing documentation, not a meaningful open implementation donor.
